title: 數值天氣預報計算管線
summary: 以流體 PDE、資料同化與集合預報串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect fluid pdes, data assimilation and ensemble forecasts with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 方程與觀測
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「方程與觀測」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop equations and observations through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 預報邊界：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「預報邊界」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Variables, domain and lead time define the task. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Define a toy temperature field and forecast window. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
